title: Austin: Planning Streets, Sewers & Service Cars
summary:
*   **Urban Planning Updates**: Approved significant land plat revisions, including changing street layouts, reducing the width of Oakwood/West 22 1/2 Street, and vacating parts of alleys.
*   **Infrastructure Investment**: Allocated funds for the construction of new sanitary sewer lines in several areas of the city.
*   **Transportation Regulation**: Granted numerous licenses to "service car" drivers, signaling the city's oversight of early public transportation services.
*   **Building Permits**: Approved a permit for Walter Tips Hardware Co. to erect a new steel and galvanized iron storage building.

The.Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, P J Lawless of
Austin, Texas, on February 27th 1896,had made a plat of Outlets 29 & 30,Division "D" of
the City of Austin, Texas, which said map or plat was in due time filed and recorded in
the deed records of Travis County, Texas,a copy of same deposited with the City Assessor &
Collector of this City ; and Whereas, said P J Lawless desired that said above described
plat of Outlets Nos 29& 30 , Division "D" of the City of Austin,Texas, be altered,changed
and modifiedin some minor particulars and also to plat Outlets Nos 41 & 42,Division "D",of
the City of Austin, Texas, in form and manner not only advantageous to himself , but, as
the City Council believes , highly advantageous and beneficial to the City of Austin and
the citizens thereof; and Whereas, the said City Council of the City of Austin,did on the
22nd day of March A D 1916,by resolution duly passed and approved on said day alter,change
and modify said plat of said Outlots Nos 29 & 30, Division "D"to which was added a plat of
Outlets Nos 41 & 42, Division "D" of the Outlets of the City of Austin, Texas, made by H F
Kuehne,on July 30th 1915,and approved and adopted said plat made by H F Kuehne in lieu of
and a substitute for the plat of Outlets 29 & 30 Division "D"of the City of Austin ,Texas,
surveyed and drawn by J W Maxey for P J Lawless, February 27th 1896; a copy of which was
deposited with the
Assessor & Collector of this City; and
Whereas, said P J Lawless now desires that said resolution be changed and amended so as to
cancel and rescind the action of the City Council of the City of Austin in adopting and
approving said plat of Outlets Nos 29 & 30,Division "D"to which was added a plat of
Outlets Nos 41& 42 Division "D" of the Outlets of the City of Austin, Texas, made by H F
KuehneJuly 30, 1915, by said resolution adopted and approved March 22nd 1916 as aforesaid;
and that it be rescinded ,cancelled and henceforth held for naught; and that,the plat of
Outlets 29 & 30 Division "D" of the Outlets of the City of Austin, Texas, made by H F
Maddox,Surveyor, on May 27th 1916, and recorded in plat records of Travis County, Texas,
in Book No 3 ,page 43 be approved and adopted in lieu of and substitute for said plats of
Outlets Nos 29 & 30, Division "D" of the City of Austin, Texas, platted by said H F Kuehne
on July 30,1915, and by Jno W Maxey for P J Lawless February 27, 1896; and Whereas, it is
thebelief of the City Council that it will not effect injuriouslyany private or vested
right by adopting said new plat of said OutletsNos 29 & 30,Division "D" of the City of
Austin, Texas, and that it will be advantageous and beneficial to the City of Austin and
the Citizens thereof, therefore, Be itresolved by the City Council of the City of Austin :
That, as a preliminary to the adoption of said substituted plat, of Outlets 29 & 30
,Divisi "D", Oakwood,or West 22 ½ street ,be and the same is hereby reduced in width from
Sixty to Fifty feet ; and the part of the West 22 ½ street ,or Oakwood street, beginning
at the West line of Longwood street,which intersects said Oakwood or West 22 ½ street ,and
proceeds westwardly ,be and the same is hereby declared vacated and no longer a public
throughfare, and that part of the alley which lies between West 22 and West 22½ streets
and which begins 480 feet West of Longview street in Outlet No 29 Division "D" and
proceeding westwardly, be and the same is hereby declared vacant.
That said plat of Outlets 29 & 30 Division "D" to which was added a plat of Outlots Nos 41
& 42, Division "D" of the Outlets of the City of Austin, Texas, made by H F Kuehne July
30, 1916,which was adopted by resolution of the City Council of the City of Austins on
March 22nd 1916, and approved by the Mayor on the same day and the plat of Outlets 29 & 30
Division "D"made and drawn by Jno W Maxey for P J Lawless on February 27th 1896,be and the
same is hereby cancelled ,rescinded and henceforth held for naught.

Walter Tips Co.
Building Permit

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin, Texas: That the petition of Walter Tips Hardware Co., dated June
13th 1916, and attached hereto, be and the same is hereby granted, and leave is granted
the said Walter Tips Hardware Cote erect upon the south ½ of Lot No 2, Block 83 City of
Austin, Texas, a structure no part of which is to be built of wood but of steel or iron
framework and galvanized iron side and top, in which to store material, the property of
said Walter Tips Hardware Co.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Councilman Bartholomew 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
The Council then adjourned.
